claim_boundary: Repository hadronic-surrogate versus analytic CFL MIT-bag discrimination with held-out fixed EoS baselines

source_audit.selection_rule: Start from provenance-screened A=0 baselines passing the 2.0 Msun sensitivity screen; remove MDI-3 because it breaches the shared R1.4 screen for A >= 0.03 and adds no family group beyond retained MDI-2.

grouping.rule: Every A variant of a fixed EoS and every related hadronic variant sharing family_group_id must remain in one split.
